content:
Gabriela Isabel Rubio was arrested Saturday, October 24, 2026, at 11:00 p.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged state jail felony charge of accident involving injury.

Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Gabriela Isabel Rubio is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
